run_chat_completion: run the Llama chat completion example with a checkpoint directory and tokenizer path via fire CLI
build_llama_generator: build a Llama generator from a checkpoint directory and tokenizer path with configurable sequence length and batch size
generate_batch_dialogs: generate chat completions for a batch of multi-turn dialogs with system, user, and assistant roles
configure_generation_params: configure text generation with temperature, top-p sampling, max sequence length, and max generation length parameters
run_llama_cli: run the Llama chat completion CLI tool using fire.Fire with checkpoint and tokenizer arguments
